Match sensible elevation, warm-white seamless background, soft light, scale and framing. Whole object centered with margins. No three-quarter azimuth, mirroring, detached objects, props, people, food, animals or plants. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermark or measurements.
